subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellLib: Add IsDotOrDotDot() function
reasons: Replaces a repeated two-part StrCmp pattern with a named function call across 9 files and multiple call sites
The before pattern is structurally identical in every location: (StrCmp(X, L".") == 0) || (StrCmp(X, L"..") == 0), or its negation
High repetitiveness: 9 occurrences across 8 different source files in ShellPkg
Straightforward match-and-replace: match the boolean expression and replace with IsDotOrDotDot(X) or !IsDotOrDotDot(X)
candidate_pattern: Replace `(StrCmp(E, L".") == 0) || (StrCmp(E, L"..") == 0)` with `IsDotOrDotDot(E)` (and negation form) across ShellPkg source files
